text: A young adult male with a lean build, olive skin tone, long straight black hair falling past shoulders, and a narrow face with defined cheekbones. He wears a sleeveless red tunic with a V-neckline and a small dark X-shaped detail at the chest. His posture is upright, facing slightly left, gazing forward with a neutral expression. Behind him, another figure’s profile is partially visible—older, bearded, in reddish-brown robes—with a distant rocky landscape under a pale sky.
